eligibility.populationObserved: equalUnit eligible and population_available=True and population>0
eligibility.missingRegime: excluded from both compositions for that year and reported
eligibility.missingPopulation: retained in equal-unit composition, excluded from observed-population composition and bounded

estimands.unitShare: state unit count / eligible regime unit count
estimands.observedPopulationShare: state observed population / observed eligible population

missingPopulationBounds.upperDemocracyShare: (observed democracy population + missing reference mass) / world reference
missingPopulationBounds.interpretation: conservative WDI-reference bounds, not exact territorial reconciliation

h2.supportRule: for every scenario: gapLowerPp(1973)>0 AND gapUpperPp(2024)<0 AND gapUpperPp(2025)<0
h2.failRule: any mandatory defensible scenario reverses or touches zero at a required endpoint

publicEndpointGate.rule: H1 supported AND gapObservedPp_Q0(2024)<0 AND independent reproduction passes
publicEndpointGate.reason: 2025 population is a separately audited WDI extension

diagnostics: full universe versus common matched universe
source revision if another official snapshot exists
